The wind blew the cap off my head,
I wanted love, but it all went wrong instead.
I know, nothing in life can be undone.

With a running start, I'll jump off the cliff.
Here I was, and now I'm gone.

Then you'll realize who you've lost.

Here I was, and now I'm gone.

With a running start, I'll jump off the cliff.
Here I was, and now I'm gone.
And then you'll come to hate yourself,
Only realizing who you've lost.
Who you've lost, who you've lost.
